narrative:
Capita 3-statement model — FY2025 continuing actuals reconciled. Revenue GBP 1,803.8M, adjusted EBITDA GBP 173M (9.6%), adjusted operating profit GBP 117M (6.5%), profit after tax GBP 73M. Balance sheet balanced.

Income statement: cost to serve 72.7% of revenue; D&A GBP 56M on right-of-use sites, IT equipment and software.

Balance sheet: contract assets and accrued income, deferred income and the defined benefit pension deficit modelled; DSO 45 days, DPO 35 days.

Cash flow: operating cash flow GBP 80M, capex GBP 63M, free cash flow GBP 17M.

signals.title: FY2025 close — GL reconciliation
signals.excerpt: Databricks finance lakehouse GL accounts mapped to the planning COA. V_MAPPED_ACTUALS reconciles to the trial balance within rounding.

signals.title: Continuing revenue up 1.6% to £906.4m in H1
signals.excerpt: Public Service +2.4% and Pension Solutions +24.7% offset the planned Regulated Services exit; adjusted operating margin 3.6% (H1 2025: 5.3%).
